review_candidates.title: IT Operations Manager (Hands On)
review_candidates.description: IT Operations Manager (Hands On) Location: Cockeysville, MD (Hybrid) You’re the person everyone comes to when technology HAS to work. You enjoy solving problems, improving processes, and making technology simpler—not more complicated. You're just as comfortable provisioning a laptop for a new employee as you are participating in a client security audit, reviewing Microsoft 365 security settings, or explaining a technical issue to senior leadership in plain English. If you've spent your career wearing multiple IT hats in a small to mid-sized organization, this could be exactly the opportunity you've been looking for. We're seeking a hands-on IT Operations Manager to own and execute the day-to-day technology operations supporting our nationally distributed workforce. This is a working manager role—not one where you'll simply delegate work to others. You'll be the primary technology leader responsible for maintaining secure, reliable systems while partnering with our Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) to strengthen our internal IT capabilities. We want someone who can be innovative and help our teams work more efficiently using the systems we have and who can take those systems, like Microsoft 365, to the next level. Our environment is highly regulated. We support clients who trust us with sensitive information, so security, compliance, and operational excellence are part of everything we do. This role is for you if... You still enjoy being hands-on with technology every day. You've supported Windows-based environments and Microsoft 365 extensively. You understand that cybersecurity is about people, processes, and technology—not just firewalls. You've participated directly in HIPAA, client security assessments, cyber insurance reviews, or other compliance audits. You know how to balance business needs with security requirements. You enjoy finding practical, cost-effective solutions rather than throwing money at problems. You're comfortable making decisions independently while communicating clearly with non-technical leaders. You take ownership and don't wait for someone else to solve problems. This probably isn't the right opportunity if... You're looking for a large enterprise IT management position where you primarily manage people or vendors. Your experience has been focused primarily on software development or network engineering. You prefer designing enterprise infrastructure over owning day-to-day IT operations. You've never personally participated in compliance audits or security assessments. You enjoy strategy but no longer want to perform technical work yourself. What You'll Do As our Systems Administrator / IT Operations Manager, you'll own technology operations across the organization, including: Administering Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Entra ID (Azure AD), Teams, SharePoint, and Windows environments. Managing user provisioning, onboarding, offboarding, VPN access, endpoint configuration, and hardware deployment for a remote workforce. Supporting Windows desktops, laptops, servers, printers, and related infrastructure. Managing software licensing, asset inventory, and lifecycle planning. Serving as the primary liaison with our Managed Security Service Provider and other technology vendors. Participating in security audits, client security questionnaires, cyber insurance renewals, and compliance initiatives. Monitoring cybersecurity controls, endpoint protection, backups, user permissions, and security best practices. Supporting our customized business applications through testing, deployment coordination, and issue resolution. Identifying opportunities to improve efficiency through automation, AI, and process improvements while maintaining strong governance and security. Managing technology within realistic budgets, making thoughtful recommendations that maximize value. What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who brings practical experience—not just technical knowledge. Required Qualifications Five or more years of progressively responsible Systems Administration or IT Operations experience. Strong Microsoft 365 administration experience, including Exchange Online, Entra ID, Teams, SharePoint, and Windows environments. Experience provisioning users, endpoints, and remote access. Experience supporting a Windows-based organization. Working knowledge of cybersecurity principles, endpoint security, user access management, backups, and disaster recovery. Experience participating directly in compliance audits, client security reviews, HIPAA environments, cyber insurance renewals, or similar regulated environments. Excellent troubleshooting, organization, and communication skills. Ability to translate technical concepts into language business leaders understand. Preferred Qualifications Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, transportation, legal, financial services, or another highly regulated industry. Experience working alongside a Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP). Familiarity with HIPAA, PII, PHI, security questionnaires, and vendor risk assessments. Experience supporting organizations with approximately 50–500 employees. Industry certifications such as Security+, Network+, Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP), Microsoft 365, Azure Administrator, or equivalent. Why You'll Enjoy This Role This position offers the opportunity to make a measurable impact. You'll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to influence technology decisions while remaining technically engaged. If you're energized by improving operations, strengthening security, solving real business problems, and helping a growing organization succeed, we'd love to meet you. If you're the kind of IT professional who enjoys rolling up your sleeves, thrives in a collaborative environment, and believes the best technology solutions are both secure and practical, we encourage you to apply. Work Environment: This position is primarily onsite, allowing only 1 day a week to work from home and when the other team member is OOO, you'll be required to work the whole time in office. The job requires dedicated and uninterrupted time identical to the conditions of working in an office environment when working from home. The content of information received and communicated contains confidential information, including PHI. While performing the duties of this job, it is the responsibility of this position to make all efforts to secure the clients confidentiality and always protect clients PHI information. The hybrid worker must abide by the Remote Work Policy. Pay on this role is between 115K-130K. ASAP provides a full array of benefits to include medical, dental, vision, life insurance, PTO/Sick leave, and 401(k). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment, transfer, or promotion without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information marital status, veteran status or any other protected status under federal and state laws. ASAP provides reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Lead SD-WAN engineering across branch offices, data centres, cloud environments, SaaS platforms, secure web gateways, and local Internet breakout. Engineer Internet edge and peering solutions, including transit, carrier interconnections, route policy, DNS dependencies, DDoS mitigation, capacity planning, resiliency, and performance optimisation. Develop and maintain network standards, reference architectures, configuration templates, engineering procedures, operational documentation, and support handover materials. Lead laboratory validation, proof-of-concept testing, pilot deployments, technology evaluations, and technical aspects of RFI and RFP activities. Provide advanced escalation support for complex incidents, performance problems, interoperability issues, and major service disruptions, including root cause analysis and corrective actions. Partner with Network Operations and Service Management to ensure solutions comply with change management, ITSM, monitoring, security, and operational readiness requirements. Collaborate with service providers, carriers, cloud providers, and OEMs to resolve technical issues, assess product capabilities, and improve service performance and resilience. Drive automation and Infrastructure-as-Code practices using APIs, scripting, source control, and repeatable deployment and validation methods. Integrate network monitoring, telemetry, analytics, observability, and AIOps capabilities to improve visibility, capacity management, fault detection, and service assurance. Mentor engineers, conduct technical design reviews, share engineering knowledge, and promote consistent application of sound engineering principles across the global team. Stay current with networking technologies, industry standards, security threats, and vendor roadmaps, and recommend practical improvements aligned with GCS strategy. Deep hands-on experience with BGP, OSPF, routing policy, route redistribution, QoS, traffic engineering, network resiliency, multicast, and IPv4/IPv6. Strong experience with SD-WAN architecture, implementation, migration, policy design, application-aware routing, local Internet breakout, segmentation, and operational support. Strong understanding of global and local Internet operations, transit and peering, Autonomous Systems, IP addressing, DNS, Internet Exchange Points, carrier interconnections, and DDoS mitigation. Hands-on experience designing and operating B2B IPsec and L2TP VPNs, secure partner connectivity, and extranet services. Strong knowledge of hybrid cloud networking and private cloud connectivity, with experience particularly in Microsoft Azure ExpressRoute. Familiarity with AWS and Google Cloud networking is desirable. Proficiency in enterprise LAN switching, office Wi-Fi, wireless security and radio fundamentals, guest networking, branch network design, and NAC or enterprise authentication platforms. Knowledge of network security principles, segmentation, Zero Trust concepts, infrastructure hardening, access controls, and secure network design. Experience with network automation using Python, REST APIs, Ansible or equivalent tools, Infrastructure-as-Code approaches, JSON, YAML, and source control. Experience with network monitoring, telemetry, packet analysis, performance management, observability, analytics, and capacity planning tools. Working knowledge of service provider technologies and services, Ethernet services, MPLS, carrier diversity, circuit delivery, and service assurance processes. Strong analytical, diagnostic, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make sound decisions during complex incidents and time-sensitive technical situations. Ability to lead multiple complex engineering initiatives, manage shifting priorities, and deliver outcomes across global and culturally diverse teams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document complex designs and explain technical issues to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to see the larger enterprise picture, identify cross-domain dependencies and trade-offs, and provide clear technical direction from initial concept through design approval and implementation. Strong collaboration, influencing, mentoring, and stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, architecture, operations, security, cloud, vendor, and business teams. Self-starter with a practical, outcome-focused mindset and flexibility to support global activities outside regular business hours when required. Job Requirements: Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related technical discipline. A Master's degree is an advantage. Experience: Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in enterprise or service provider networking, including substantial hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting large-scale WAN, SD-WAN, Internet, B2B VPN, and cloud connectivity solutions. Experience leading complex global engineering projects and providing senior technical escalation support is required. Certification Requirements: A current Cisco CCNP Enterprise or equivalent professional-level network certification is preferred. CCIE Routing and Switching, CCIE Service Provider, Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate, Versa or other vendor-specific SD-WAN certifications, or relevant cloud networking certifications are strong value additions. review_candidates.title: Solution Architect – Cloud Infrastructure & Migration
review_candidates.description: Job Title : Solution Architect – Cloud Infrastructure & Migration Company : Host360 Location : Onsite (Mumbai - Andheri East) Employment Type : Full Time Experience: 4–12 Years Function: Solution Architecture / Technical Pre-Sales Focus: Solution Architecture | Cloud Migration CTC – As per Industry Standards Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect with strong expertise in cloud infrastructure, private cloud platforms, enterprise networking, storage, and complex migrations, particularly migrating workloads from AWS, Microsoft Azure, and GCP to on-premises private cloud environments. Key Responsibilities Lead customer discovery, technical workshops, solution presentations, and infrastructure assessments. Design private, public, and hybrid cloud solutions using OpenStack/RHOSP, VMware, Proxmox, AWS, and Azure. Architect compute, storage, networking, security, backup, disaster recovery, and high-availability solutions. Design and plan complex cloud repatriation projects from AWS, Azure, and GCP to on-premises private cloud platforms. Assess workloads, application dependencies, cloud-native services, data migration requirements, and target infrastructure capacity. Develop migration strategies, workload mapping, migration waves, cutover plans, rollback procedures, and downtime mitigation approaches. Prepare HLDs, LLDs, BOMs, SOWs, infrastructure sizing, effort estimates, and technical-commercial proposals. Design enterprise networking and security solutions involving Fortinet, Check Point, BGP, multi-site data centers, and colocation. Leverage Ansible, Terraform, scripting, and automation for infrastructure provisioning and migration. Identify technical risks, cost implications, licensing requirements, and delivery dependencies before commercial commitments. Collaborate with sales, engineering, and delivery teams to ensure solution feasibility and smooth project handover. Required Technical Skills Cloud Platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, OpenStack/RHOSP, VMware, Proxmox.
